pass_1.finding: Methods print: 0.5% formaldehyde (138 ul 37% in 10 ml NWB; GEO prints 140 ul) 10 min on ice, glycine stop; transposon annealing of 5'P read 1/read 2 barcoded oligos with 5'P/3'ddC ME-complement (85 C, -1 C/min), Robustnique Tn5 M0221 loading 37 C 30 min, 48 combinations; round-2 universal and round-3 well-specific linkers pre-annealed with barcode strands in 10 mM Tris/50 mM NaCl (95 C, -1 C/min) giving a 5' overhang complementary to the transposed end; transposition 37 C 30 min, EDTA/spermidine stop; two hybridization-ligation rounds in 1.5x T4 ligase buffer with 60 U/ul NEB M0202L T4 DNA ligase, 37 C 30 min (10 U/ul for species mixing); proteinase K/SDS 65 C 16 h, Triton quench; KAPA KK2602 PCR with i5/i7 index primers (Supplementary Table 1), 11 cycles (13 for species mixing), 1x SPRIselect; PE150 on NovaSeq 6000 or DNBSEQ-T7; genomic spans R1 66-121, R2 51-101. All oligo sequences are referred to Supplementary Table 1 (row supp_table_1); no MGI conversion route is printed. The molecular order agrees with the model; only the fixation volume source discrepancy was found (model now uses the published value and the page shows both).

pass_2.finding: Agrees with pass 1 on: 5'P read 1/read 2 barcoded transposon oligos annealed with 5'P/3'ddC ME-complement (85 C 2 min, -1 C/min to 20 C), 48 combinations, Robustnique Tn5 M0221 loading 37 C 30 min; round-2 universal and round-3 well-specific linkers annealed (10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 50 mM NaCl; 95 C 2 min, -1 C/min); transposition 37 C 30 min 300 rpm, EDTA/spermidine stop; two hybridization-ligation rounds in a 1.06 ml ligation mix (1.5x T4 ligation buffer, 60 U/ul T4 DNA ligase NEB M0202L, 0.15% Triton X-100, 0.36x NWB), 20 ul nuclei onto 10 ul barcodes, 37 C 30 min 50 rpm, EDTA/spermidine stop (species mixing 10 U/ul ligase final); proteinase K/SDS 65 C 16 h, Triton quench, PCR with 2x KAPA Master Mix KK2602, 72 C 10 min, 98 C 45 s, 11 cycles (98/62/72 C), 72 C 5 min (13 cycles species mixing), 1x SPRIselect, PE150 NovaSeq 6000 or DNBSEQ-T7; fixation 138 ul 37% FA (0.5%) vs GEO 140 ul. Additional findings, not harmonised: (1) Extended Data Fig. 1a row '4th BC-indexed PCR' draws the round-3 barcode as [NNNNNNN] (7 N) while row '3rd BC-ligation', every Supplementary Table 1 Tn5_R_L oligo (8 bases after S7+ME) and the figure's own 50-nt Read 2 bracket require 8 -- a figure-internal discrepancy, now shown on the page (model keeps 8). Otherwise the rendered panel agrees with the model: 5'P stars on both round-1 leader ends; round-2 oligo ACGACGCTCTTCCGATCT-[N8]-ATCCACGTGCTTGAG with left linker TAGGTGCACGAACTCTCCGGTCT drawn 3'->5' (= reverse of Tn5_F_LA); right linker CGCCGATG-[N8]-CTGTCTC (= Tn5_R_LA pattern); round-3 oligo S7+ME+[N8] drawn 3'->5'; P5-i5-TruSeq Read 1 and P7-i7-S7 arms; 65-nt Read 1 and 50-nt Read 2 prefixes. (2) The 60 U/ul ligase value is the ligation-mix concentration (20 ul mix + 10 ul barcodes gives ~40 U/ul final, computed), while the species-mixing 10 U/ul is printed as final. (3) The 66-121 / 51-101 genomic positions are printed in the species-mixing processing paragraph; the zebrafish paragraph does not restate positions (pass 1 and the page generalise them). (4) Nuclei homogenization is printed as 'pipetting ten times each with pestle A and pestle B' in a 2 ml Dounce; the earlier graph label '10 strokes' paraphrased this and now quotes it. (5) The PCR mix is named only '2x KAPA Master Mix (KK2602; Roche)'; no product name beyond that is printed. (6) The P5/P7 library conversion for DNBSEQ-T7 is not printed in the Methods (agrees with pass 1).
